course_name_original: UE Mathématiques pour les sciences de l'ingénieur - MAT405 -
syllabus_topics: Image and kernel of a matrix; rank theorem; solutions of a system (general and specific cases - square, compatible, homogeneous)

Eigenvalues; characteristic polynomial; eigenspace; multiplicity orders of an eigenvalue; diagonalization (conditions: general case and real symmetric matrix); orthogonal matrix; singular value decomposition (SVD)
TP applications of SVD: matrix conditioning; image compression
Differential equations (ODE) and systems of ODEs
Classification (order, linearity); first-order ODE system; link between ODE and system; Cauchy problem; equilibrium states; phase plane and vector field;
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
